chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, who said:
When the throes of death become intense for him, then place him in his place of salat (prayer), where he used to perform salat, or upon it.

key_terms.النَّزْعُ: the throes or agonies of death

ai.seo_question: What should be done for a person when the throes of death become severe according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an instruction concerning a dying person when the agony of death intensifies. It directs that he be placed in the spot where he used to perform salat, indicating the spiritual importance of familiar places of worship at the time of death.
